policy.intro: At Neurofit IA we are committed to protecting and respecting our users' privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, store and protect the personal data obtained through our contact forms, newsletter subscriptions (email marketing) and interest registrations for our services focused on assessing, treating and improving the quality of life of people with Alzheimer's and their families.

purpose.intro: The personal data collected will be used for the following purposes:
items: Send newsletters and email marketing campaigns with news, progress and updates about Neurofit IA.
Contact interested people to provide advice or detailed information about our assessment and treatment services.
Perform internal statistical analysis to improve our services and the user experience.

rights.intro: As the owner of the information, you have the right to:
items: Access, update and rectify your personal data held by Neurofit IA.
Request proof of the authorization granted for the processing of your data.
Be informed about how your personal data has been used.
Withdraw your authorization and/or request deletion of the data at any time, especially if you no longer wish to receive email marketing communications.
Access your processed personal data free of charge.

security.text: At Neurofit IA we implement the technical, human and administrative measures needed to keep records secure, preventing their alteration, loss, or unauthorized or fraudulent consultation, use or access. Information is stored on secure email management platforms and databases with restricted access.

sensitive.alertText: Given the nature of our project (focused on Alzheimer's), users may voluntarily share information about their own health or that of a family member. Such data is considered sensitive.
items: Neurofit IA guarantees that providing sensitive data is strictly optional and voluntary for the user.
That information will be used solely and exclusively to better understand the user's needs and to properly guide information about our services.
